entities.name: Dyfed
entities.description: The Thran planeswalker who showed Yawgmoth Phyrexia for the first time and was later killed by him. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The most important healer of the Thran Empire, who seized control of it and became god of Phyrexia.

entities.name: Glacian
entities.description: The master artificer of the Thran Empire who proved the existence of the Multiverse.

entities.name: Rebbec
entities.description: A Thran who with Glacian summoned Dyfed and later found and killed the priests working on her.

entities.name: Thran Empire
entities.description: The empire that Yawgmoth forcibly took control of.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The metal plane that Yawgmoth wanted to make his paradise and fused himself with.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane from which Dyfed opened a portal to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: The plane to which Dyfed took the elders of the Thran Empire.

entities.name: Thran-Phyrexian War
entities.description: The war during which Dyfed went to Phyrexia and died.

entities.name: Thran Alliance
entities.description: The alliance to which Dyfed ordered Yawgmoth to surrender.

events.summary: Dyfed visits Glacian; Yawgmoth walks in and talks her into aiding him, and she gifts him an amulet.
events.quote: Dyfed fell for the charming words of Yawgmoth and agreed to find a plane where Yawgmoth could build a paradise for all the Thran.

events.summary: After Yawgmoth seizes the empire, Dyfed takes the imprisoned elders to Mercadia.
events.quote: Dyfed agreed to help Glacian, and took the elders, along with several goblin servants, to the plane of Mercadia

events.summary: Dyfed opens a permanent portal from Dominaria to Phyrexia, letting Yawgmoth become its god.
events.quote: Dyfed opened a permanent portal from Dominaria to Phyrexia

events.summary: Dyfed confronts Yawgmoth on Phyrexia, is horrified by his experiments, and he stabs her in the skull to stop her planeswalking.
events.quote: Yawgmoth, taking advantage of Dyfed's horror, stabbed her in the skull with a powerstone blade

events.summary: Rebbec finds the tortured Dyfed and kills the priests working on her, allowing her to die.
events.quote: Rebbec found the tortured planeswalker and killed the priests working on her, allowing Dyfed to finally die.

relations.note: Stabbed her and had her vivisected.
relations.quote: Yawgmoth had his minions vivisect her

relations.note: Agreed to help Glacian rescue the elders.
